idea: crypto-autoresearcher IDEA-20261015-b41f68 (stage 1 pointer-chase null; stage 2 huge-page pair), uncommitted proposal
question: On one GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runner (a VM), does backing B's n=83 K600 IC producer with 2 MiB transparent huge pages lower its ns per root-index probe on Q0 by at least 1.5x, while the tuned rho's ns per step moves by under 5%; and how does IC ns/probe compare with a pointer chase over the root table's byte size under the same page policy?
measurement_tier: tier1_instance (one runner, one pinned exposed CPU; host exclusivity not certified)

inputs.restore: experiments/koblitz-n83-reconcile-20261014/restore_sources.py (crypto 770f6a69 and a8194d61, digest-checked); crate experiments/koblitz-n83-reconcile-20261014/crates/r770, bins ic_online_logcache_r770 and rho_tuned_r770 only, rustc 1.99.0, --locked
inputs.root_table_bytes_derivation: RootTable128::with_capacity(2*states): (4*29,880,000).next_power_of_two() = 2^27 slots of (u128,u64) = 32 bytes (crypto 770f6a69 examples/koblitz_orbit_dlp_fast_online.rs, wide path); peak RSS 5.81 GB in run 38689817618

arms.4k: producer started with prctl(PR_SET_THP_DISABLE, 1): no transparent huge pages anywhere in the process
arms.thp: producer started with GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.malloc.hugetlb=1: glibc madvise(MADV_HUGEPAGE) on its mmap'd chunks (the 4 GiB root table and the 1.4 GB state vector); the system THP mode is left as the runner has it and recorded
arms.hugetlb: pointer chase only: MAP_HUGETLB|MAP_HUGE_2MB from pages the workflow reserved; not interleaved; skipped if the reservation fails
arms.default: no prctl, no tunable: the runner's own THP mode decides, as in the earlier n=83 GitHub runs (their allocation.json: enabled=[always], defrag=[madvise]); the workflow does not change the system mode

pointer_chase.source: pchase.c (gcc -O2), one dependent load per access, 64-byte slots, one Sattolo cycle, anonymous memory only

ic_panel.order: block k runs block_orders[k]; each 4k or thp IC process is followed by a pointer chase over null_size_bytes under the same policy
ic_panel.producer: B's ic_online_logcache_r770 with the verified cached log table (kind ic_online_cached of the reconcile arm.py, unchanged)
ic_panel.metric: ns per probe = producer online_ms * 1e6 / probes (the producer's five-phase online clock)

rho_panel.order: as ic_panel, without the pointer chase

statistics.primary: R_IC = geometric mean over the 4 blocks of (ns/probe 4k) / (ns/probe thp); 95% interval from the t distribution on the 4 log ratios (3 df, t = 3.182)
statistics.rho: R_rho, the same statistic on ns/step
statistics.null: per pair, pointer-chase ns/access 4k over thp at null_size_bytes, and the IC ns/probe over the same-policy pointer-chase ns/access
statistics.sweep: per size and mode, median over the two rounds of each run's median ns/access
statistics.secondary: the same statistic for default/thp and 4k/default (ties the earlier runs' as-run policy to both ends)

decision_rule.eligible: every IC and rho row valid and verified; every IC row 8,845,441 probes and scalar 3141592653589793; every rho row 12,592,070 steps; the default arm carries no page-count condition (it is recorded); manipulation check passes: every thp IC process shows max AnonHugePages >= 2,097,152 kB (half the root table) and every 4k IC process shows 0; pointer chase at >= 1 GiB shows anon_huge_kb >= 90% of the size under thp and 0 under 4k. Otherwise the reading is no_result.

ic_readings.thp_cuts_ic_ns_per_probe_ge_1.5x: R_IC >= 1.5 and the interval's lower bound > 1
ic_readings.thp_change_under_10pct: the whole interval inside [0.9, 1.1] (the idea's falsification condition: TLB mechanism wrong)

decision_rule.idea_prediction_4: met if ic reading is thp_cuts_ic_ns_per_probe_ge_1.5x and rho reading is rho_change_under_5pct
decision_rule.baseline_improvement: If the IC reading is thp_cuts_*, the thp page policy is a measured online-stage improvement of B's K600 IC on this instance (engineering class, AGENTS.md success criterion); the setup (index build) change per arm is reported beside it, and the gap to the tuned rho on Q0 is reported on every row.

what_does_not_count: changing pairs, sizes, policies or the reading thresholds after seeing a timing
pooling this runner with any other host
any timing from the local container (smoke only)
reading a pointer-chase ratio as an IC speedup
